name: treasury_ap_routing
description: Route treasury and accounts payable requests to one of five agents, or flag them as out of scope.

agent.instructions: Which agent should handle this treasury or accounts payable request

criteria.payment_search: Look up specific payments or transactions (wire, ACH, RTP, check) and their details or current status: sent, pending, settled, rejected, returned, tracking references, amounts paid to a payee
criteria.reconciliation_report: Generate a reconciliation report as a PDF or Excel file, such as matching bank activity to the ledger or invoices, month-end recons, or exports of unmatched items
criteria.entitlements: Request a change to access or permissions for the user or a colleague: higher payment or approval limits, approver rights, access to accounts, modules, or roles
criteria.balance_liquidity: Look up live account balances or overall liquidity: current, available, or ledger balances, cash position across accounts or entities, intraday or forecast liquidity
criteria.faq: Explain how to do something or how a process, policy, or term works, answered from documentation rather than by looking up live data or taking an action
criteria.out_of_scope: Anything the other agents cannot do, such as creating, approving, or editing payments or vendor records, or requests unrelated to treasury and payables
